units.characteristics: the settled cruelty of the nations; Israel's oppression of the poor as covenant sin
units.gist: the 'for THREE transgressions and for FOUR' cycle against the nations, closing on Judah (rejected the law) and Israel - 'they SELL THE RIGHTEOUS for silver, the needy for a pair of sandals; TRAMPLE THE HEAD OF THE POOR into the dust'; cruelty that 'kept his wrath forever' (Edom) - hardened, entrenched sin; oppression of the weak as the covenant's breaking-point

units.characteristics: intimacy raises responsibility; the prophetic compulsion
units.gist: GEM - 'YOU ONLY HAVE I KNOWN of all the families of the earth; THEREFORE I will punish you for all your iniquities' - being known/chosen INCREASES accountability, not exempts; 'the lion has roared; who will not FEAR? the Lord GOD has spoken; who CAN BUT PROPHESY?' - the compulsion of the one who has heard God

units.characteristics: the discipline that did not turn the heart; 'prepare to meet your God'
units.gist: GEM - the fivefold refrain 'YET YOU DID NOT RETURN TO ME' (famine, drought, blight, pestilence, overthrow - each meant to turn them, none did); the empty zeal at Bethel ('come to Bethel and TRANSGRESS... for so you LOVE to do'); 'therefore PREPARE TO MEET YOUR GOD, O Israel' - correction that failed to produce return; misdirected religious love

units.characteristics: seek God and live; justice over ritual; the misjudged day of the LORD
units.gist: THE GEM - 'SEEK ME AND LIVE'; 'SEEK GOOD, AND NOT EVIL, that you may live... HATE EVIL, and LOVE GOOD, and establish justice'; 'I HATE, I DESPISE your feasts... take away the noise of your songs; BUT LET JUSTICE ROLL DOWN LIKE WATERS, and righteousness like an ever-flowing stream'; 'woe to you who DESIRE the day of the LORD - it is darkness, not light'

units.characteristics: complacent ease; the heart un-grieved by others' ruin; self-strength
units.gist: GEM - 'WOE TO THOSE WHO ARE AT EASE IN Zion, who feel SECURE... who lie on beds of ivory... drink wine in bowls and anoint themselves with the finest oils, BUT ARE NOT GRIEVED OVER THE RUIN OF JOSEPH'; 'the PRIDE of Jacob'; 'have we not by OUR OWN STRENGTH captured Karnaim?' - luxury that feels nothing for others' pain; self-securing pride

units.characteristics: the prophet's intercession; the plumb line; the courage to speak under threat
units.gist: GEM - the visions (locusts, fire): Amos intercedes 'O Lord GOD, please FORGIVE! how can Jacob stand? HE IS SO SMALL', and 'the LORD RELENTED'; the PLUMB LINE set in the midst - the measure held to the heart; then Amaziah orders him to stop, and Amos: 'the LORD TOOK ME from following the flock and said, Go, prophesy' - intercession, the measuring standard, and courage under threat

units.characteristics: greed that resents the Sabbath; the famine of hearing God's word
units.gist: THE GEM - the greedy who ask 'when will the NEW MOON be over... the SABBATH, that we may sell?' (resenting the rest that interrupts profit), 'make the ephah small and the shekel great... buy the poor for silver'; then 'I will send a FAMINE on the land - not of bread... BUT OF HEARING THE WORDS OF THE LORD; they shall run to and fro to seek the word of the LORD, but shall not find it'

units.characteristics: no hiding from God's presence; the sieve; the fallen booth raised
units.gist: GEM - 'if they DIG INTO SHEOL, from there my hand shall take them; if they CLIMB TO HEAVEN, from there I will bring them down... if they hide at the bottom of the sea' - no escape from God's presence (Ps 139 in judgment); the SIEVE that loses no true grain; then hope - 'I will RAISE UP the booth of David that is fallen... I will RESTORE the fortunes of my people... never again be uprooted'
